why: LEAD RULING L-212 (R-104 F line): Firestorm, the Nuclear Man #65-92 (27 files 54991-55017, 1987-09 onward, 23-25pp, per-file CV 3789 / GCD 3357 x27) is the retitled continuation of The Fury of Firestorm #1-64 (S65956, R-104 S line cv=3115 gcd=2628, whose #64 is dated 1987-07) in the SAME folder 'DC\Firestorm\Firestorm v2 (1982)'; Annual #5 (54982, 1987, 40pp) continues S65956's Fury of Firestorm Annual #1-4 (55018-55021). Both providers keep two records (CV 3115/3789, GCD 2628/3357) so no shared-cv merge can land it — all 28 items JOIN S65956 by its exact key 'The Fury of Firestorm (1982)'; this shelf empties by design of the join

LEAD RULING L-212 (R-104 F line): Batman and the Outsiders (2007) #1-14 (62292-62305, CV 19660 / GCD 27224, 14), the Special #1 (62306, 2009) and the stray '41 Batman and the Outsiders 040 (2011)' (62332) sit in ONE folder '03 Batman and the Outsiders v2 (2008)' numbered 01-41 continuously with S66031's 'The Outsiders 015-039 (2009)' files 16-40 — the 2009 retitle continued this run's numbering at #15 (S66031 R-104 S line cv=25804 gcd=34024, cached #15-40). Both providers keep two records (19660/25804, 27224/34024), so no shared-cv merge can land it — all 16 items JOIN S66031 by its exact key 'The Outsiders (2009)'; this shelf empties by design of the join. Nearby S102451 (1983 series, cv=3194) and S4182 (Convergence) are other runs — the per-file 3194 stamp here is the wrong-relaunch trap
